newsitem.title: USA: Anheuser-Busch to issue $250 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Anheuser-Busch to issue $250 mln in debt.

text.p: Anheuser-Busch Cos Inc is expected to tap the corporate bond primary market with a $250 million debt offering, syndicate sources said on Monday.
The issue is expected to include a 20-year maturity, callable after ten years, sources said.
Underwriters on the offering are expected to include Dillon Read, Goldman Sachs & Co and JP Morgan Securities, they said.
Anheuser-Busch, headquartered in St. Louis, is the world's largest brewer and holds a 45-percent share of the U.S. beer market.
